#EDA 


```{r}
#EDA of total revenue for appliances and electronics
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(walmart, aes(x = category, y = unit_price, fill = category)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Appliances" = "purple",
                               "Electronics" = "red")) +
  labs(title = "Unit Price by Category",
       x = "Category",
       y = "Unit Price") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(walmart, aes(x = category, y = quantity_sold, fill = category)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Appliances" = "purple",
                               "Electronics" = "red")) +
  labs(title = "Quantity Sold by Category",
       x = "Category",
       y = "Quantity Sold") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(walmart, aes(x = category, y = customer_age, fill = category)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Appliances" = "purple",
                               "Electronics" = "red")) +
  labs(title = "Customer Age by Category",
       x = "Category",
       y = "Customer Age") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(walmart, aes(x = category, fill = customer_gender)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Gender Distribution by Category",
       x = "Category",
       y = "Number of Transactions",
       fill = "Gender")
```
The data looks very similar across all of the plots.

```{r}
t.test(unit_price ~ category, data = walmart)

t.test(quantity_sold ~ category, data = walmart)

t.test(customer_age ~ category, data = walmart)

```


the t-tests were used to show any sigificant differences in unit_price,quantity sold, customer age, and revenue within the the two categories and three of them seem to reject the nullhypothesis. There isn't a difference in three of the tests. However customer age and category accept the alternate hypothesis. 


```{r}

contable_gender = table(walmart$category, walmart$customer_gender)
chisq.test(contable_gender)

```

Similarily, the chi-square test didn't show a disparity between genders as sales seem to be the same among genders.


```
